faq.q: How much does Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein charge?
faq.a: Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein have offices?
faq.a: Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein publishes two offices, in Manhattan and Manhasset. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein?
faq.a: Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein publishes 15 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein?
faq.a: Law Office of Aaron Wallenstein scores 48 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: entity registration and website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
